svg.title: Morph: Model Optimization / Llm Compression
svg.desc: Morph. Depth-compresses Hugging Face causal LMs, then uses teacher–student distillation to recover what pruning loses. Selects transformer blocks uniformly across the teacher's depth and transfers their weights into a smaller student Objective: next-token CE + temperature-scaled KL to the teacher + optional hidden-state MSE 4/8-bit teacher quantization, BF16/FP16, gradient checkpointing; Llama, Mistral, Qwen2, GPT-2, Falcon, OPT, NeoX
